<function=python>

def state(f):
    P=[]; Y=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='p':
            rows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])); cols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))
            if rows[0]>5: P.append((n['pixels'],rows[0],rows[-1],cols[0],cols[-1]))
        if n['color']=='Y':
            rows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])); cols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))
            if rows[0]>5: Y.append((n['pixels'],rows[0],rows[-1],cols[0],cols[-1]))
    return P,Y
for i in range(3):
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':37,'col':31}])
    P,Y = state(current_frame)
    print(f"after click {i+1}:", "P:",P,"Y:",Y, "step:", current_frame.step)
    if res and (res.get('game_over') or res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed')):
        print("STOP:", res); break
    if Y: print("YELLOW CREATED"); break
    if len(P)<2: print("PURPLES <2, stop"); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
